intro: My research focuses on developing and applying computational methods to understand complex biological systems and human diseases.

areas.title: Bioinformatics and Systems Biology
areas.description: Integration and analysis of multi-omics data (transcriptomics, epigenomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, proteomics) to identify molecular mechanisms underlying human diseases.

areas.title: Ontology-Based Knowledge Systems
areas.description: Development of interoperable ontologies and AI-driven frameworks for data standardization, integration, and literature mining (e.g., VIOLIN, OLAS, MILAM).

areas.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
areas.description: Application of deep learning and natural language processing to biomedical data, focusing on biological age prediction, disease modeling, and knowledge extraction.

areas.title: Neurological Disorders
areas.description: Focus on diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN), metabolic syndrome-associated cognitive impairment, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), in collaboration with Drs. Eva Feldman and Stephen Goutman (University of Michigan).

areas.title: Host-Pathogen Interactions
areas.description: Ontology-based modeling of infectious diseases and immune responses, in collaboration with Dr. Yongqun He (University of Michigan).
